// Starts a Stripe Checkout session for the signed-in workspace.
//
// verify_jwt is on: only a signed-in admin may buy, and the workspace is taken
// from their token, never from the request body — otherwise anyone could
// subscribe on someone else's behalf, or attach a card to another tenant.
//
// Who is calling is checked before anything else, including configuration, so
// an unauthenticated request is refused the same way whether or not Stripe
// keys happen to be set.

import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const STRIPE_SECRET_KEY = Deno.env.get('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY') ?? '';
const SITE_URL = Deno.env.get('SITE_URL') ?? 'https://nhrsolutions.net';

const CORS = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS'
};
const json = (b: unknown, status = 200) =>
  new Response(JSON.stringify(b), { status, headers: { ...CORS, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });

// Stripe's API is form-encoded, so no SDK is needed for these two calls.
async function stripe(path: string, form: Record<string, string>) {
  const res = await fetch('https://api.stripe.com/v1/' + path, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${STRIPE_SECRET_KEY}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
    },
    body: new URLSearchParams(form)
  });
  const body = await res.json();
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(body?.error?.message ?? 'Stripe rejected the request');
  return body;
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  if (req.method !== 'POST') return json({ error: 'method_not_allowed' }, 405);

  const caller = createClient(
    Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!,
    Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY')!,
    { global: { headers: { Authorization: req.headers.get('Authorization') ?? '' } } }
  );

  const { data: userData } = await caller.auth.getUser();
  const user = userData?.user;
  if (!user) return json({ error: 'not_signed_in' }, 401);

  if (!STRIPE_SECRET_KEY) return json({ error: 'STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is not set' }, 500);

  let body: { price_id?: string; employee_band?: string };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return json({ error: 'bad_request' }, 400);
  }
  if (!body.price_id) return json({ error: 'price_id is required' }, 400);

  // Service role: the caller's own token cannot read tenants until the access
  // token hook is registered, and billing must not depend on that.
  const admin = createClient(
    Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!,
    Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!
  );

  const { data: profile } = await admin
    .from('profiles')
    .select('tenant_id, role, email, name')
    .eq('id', user.id)
    .single();

  if (!profile) return json({ error: 'no_workspace' }, 403);
  if (!['super_admin', 'hr_admin'].includes(profile.role)) {
    return json({ error: 'not_permitted', message: 'Only an administrator can change the subscription.' }, 403);
  }

  const { data: tenant } = await admin
    .from('tenants')
    .select('id, name, stripe_customer_id, billing_email')
    .eq('id', profile.tenant_id)
    .single();

  if (!tenant) return json({ error: 'no_workspace' }, 403);

  // Reuse the customer so a workspace never ends up with two of them, which
  // would split its invoices and payment methods.
  let customerId = tenant.stripe_customer_id;
  if (!customerId) {
    const customer = await stripe('customers', {
      email: tenant.billing_email ?? profile.email,
      name: tenant.name,
      'metadata[tenant_id]': tenant.id
    });
    customerId = customer.id;
    await admin.from('tenants').update({ stripe_customer_id: customerId }).eq('id', tenant.id);
  }

  const session = await stripe('checkout/sessions', {
    mode: 'subscription',
    customer: customerId,
    'line_items[0][price]': body.price_id,
    'line_items[0][quantity]': '1',
    // The webhook reads these to know which workspace paid for what.
    'subscription_data[metadata][tenant_id]': tenant.id,
    'subscription_data[metadata][employee_band]': body.employee_band ?? '',
    'metadata[tenant_id]': tenant.id,
    client_reference_id: tenant.id,
    allow_promotion_codes: 'true',
    success_url: `${SITE_URL}/ui_kits/app/billing.html?checkout=success`,
    cancel_url: `${SITE_URL}/ui_kits/app/billing.html?checkout=cancelled`
  });

  return json({ url: session.url });
});
